metadata.description: Create a new calendar meeting event in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Create a new calendar meeting event in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify details such as the meeting title, start and end times, and associated users. The organizerUserId is required to identify the meeting organizer.

organizerUserId.label: Organizer User Id
organizerUserId.description: The unique identifier of the user organizing the meeting. This parameter is required.

associations.label: Associations
associations.description: An array of associations related to the meeting event, each represented by an ExternalAssociationCreateRequest object.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: An array of ExternalReminder objects that specify the timing and frequency of the email reminders.

shouldIncludeInviteDescription.label: Should Include Invite Description
shouldIncludeInviteDescription.description: A boolean indicating whether the invite description should be included in the email reminder.

hs_activity_type.label: Hs Activity Type
hs_activity_type.description: The type of activity for the meeting. This is a string value.

hs_attachment_ids.label: Hs Attachment Ids
hs_attachment_ids.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of attachments associated with the meeting.

hs_attendee_owner_ids.label: Hs Attendee Owner Ids
hs_attendee_owner_ids.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of the owners of the attendees for the meeting.

hs_internal_meeting_notes.label: Hs Internal Meeting Notes
hs_internal_meeting_notes.description: Internal notes for the meeting. This is a string value.

hs_meeting_body.label: Hs Meeting Body
hs_meeting_body.description: The body content or description of the meeting. This is a string value.

hs_meeting_end_time.label: Hs Meeting End Time
hs_meeting_end_time.description: The end time of the meeting, in ISO 8601 format.

hs_meeting_location.label: Hs Meeting Location
hs_meeting_location.description: The location of the meeting. This is a string value.

hs_meeting_location_type.label: Hs Meeting Location Type
hs_meeting_location_type.description: The type of location for the meeting. Valid values include 'PHONE', 'ADDRESS', and 'CUSTOM'.

hs_meeting_outcome.label: Hs Meeting Outcome
hs_meeting_outcome.description: A string representing the outcome of the meeting.

hs_meeting_start_time.label: Hs Meeting Start Time
hs_meeting_start_time.description: The start time of the meeting, in ISO 8601 format.

hs_meeting_title.label: Hs Meeting Title
hs_meeting_title.description: The title of the meeting. This is a string value.

hs_timestamp.label: Hs Timestamp
hs_timestamp.description: A timestamp indicating when the meeting event was created, in ISO 8601 format.

hubspot_owner_id.label: Hubspot Owner Id
hubspot_owner_id.description: The unique identifier of the HubSpot owner associated with the meeting.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: A string representing the timezone in which the meeting event is scheduled.
